name: FAA Type Certificate Data Sheets
update_frequency: As certificates and revisions are issued
known_limitations: A type certificate data sheet defines approved design and limitations for its scope; it does not prove production scale, operator approval, route economics, or commercial service.
jurisdiction: United States aircraft, engine, and propeller certification
automation_notes: Preserve certificate number, holder, model, revision, issue date, applicability, limitations, and document status.
notes: Primary certification artifact rail inside the FAA Dynamic Regulatory System.
